title: Vietnam Mountain Marathon — 官方主页（越南文）
claims: The Vietnamese home page says 'Mùa giải thứ 13 | 17 – 20/09/2026 | ĐÓNG ĐĂNG KÝ', i.e. the 13th season on 17-20 September 2026 with registration closed.
The same Vietnamese page says the series has raised more than VND 14.9 billion in one passage and more than VND 14.2 billion in another passage.
The Vietnamese page lists six distances — 10km, 21km, 50km, 70km, 100km and 100 miles — and describes the 100 miles as 161 km with 8,800 m of gain.

verification.note: 越南文主页仍停在 2026 届（第 13 赛季），与英文主页的 2027 dates TBD 不同步；同页慈善金额两处不一致。
